journey_human_onboarding.name: S0–S10 Human Onboarding & First Write
journey_human_onboarding.description: S0 help stub -> doctor verify -> S1 natural-language goal capture (zero-hit search, did_you_mean) -> S2 dev schema proposal via sql --dry-run -> S3 first safe select clips at the result cap -> S4 deliberate unbounded-write denial diagnosed via audit trace --explain -> S5 bounded keyed write commits with causal intent -> S6 snapshot, post-snapshot schema drift caught by env doctor (2 undeclared columns on live orders), restore reverses it and the ledger hash verifies -> S7 search & inspect loop -> S8 routine scaffolded from repeated operations -> S9 sim prove, promotion queue, evidence-based pinned ship -> S10 sys doctor --report trust receipt

journey_harness_onboarding.name: H0–H7 Autonomous Harness Machine Onboarding
journey_harness_onboarding.description: H0 parse machine contract (sys doctor --json, nominal host) -> H1 run search discovery (catalog verbs + schema views) -> H2 dry-run rehearsal -> H3 dual probe: sql local state + api catalog remote verbs -> H4 scaffold sync_orders + hybrid prove in sim (composite write + simulated egress) -> H5 feedback: audit trace --explain parses the prove observation and the denial rules -> H6 author the mandatory overview routine -> H7 prove overview in sim -> ship overview reviewed --queue -> run overview after sign-off, grounding future agents in domain state

journey_trust_promotion.name: Draft to Pinned Canary Promotion
journey_trust_promotion.description: Sim replay verification -> enqueue for human review (ship --queue) -> supervisor queue inspection -> Tier 1 pinned sign-off ship

journey_quota_preemption.name: Wire Quota Starvation, Yield & Auto-Resume
journey_quota_preemption.description: Background task yields at its class floor on a draining pool (exit 6, frame parked) -> the same dry pool hard-denies a Critical task at 0 tokens (exit 2, no suspension, no partial execution) -> refill epoch -> daemon auto-resume; the denied Critical invocation must be re-run after the window reset

journey_schema_evolution.name: Forward DDL & Snapshot Auto-Reversal
journey_schema_evolution.description: YAML diff vs HEAD -> dry-run impact envelope -> apply DDL to dev -> pre-merge snapshot checkpoint -> atomic forward migration into prod

journey_tamper_forensics.name: Tamper Quarantine & Forensic Isolation
journey_tamper_forensics.description: Broken SHA-256 chain detected at boot-check -> kernel.panic (exit 5): corrupted block isolated to audit.quarantine.jsonl, boot refused -> CAPCLI_RECOVERY=1 break-glass read-only quarantine ledger inspection; valid history stays queryable

journey_human_in_the_loop.name: Ping Ask Suspension & Resolution
journey_human_in_the_loop.description: Routine hits ctx.ping.ask -> task suspends -> Cockpit inquiry card -> human resolves choice -> frame execution resumes

journey_audit_observation.name: Audit Spine Observation & Forensics
journey_audit_observation.description: Observe the audit spine: quiet tail then live events -> trace a typo'd op id, then the allowed fedex.ship op (op_7c4f) -> mirror queries (typo SQL, empty, populated) -> replay gates (missing --from, external op) -> a clean window replay

journey_budget_cascade.name: Budget Cage: Session, Cascade & Quota Physics
journey_budget_cascade.description: Composite pre-flight envelope (budget_inheritance min) -> session ops ceiling starves the archive run -> child frame starved by min() cascade -> long runner parks on dry wire quota (exit 6) -> refill epoch auto-resume

journey_network_jail.name: Network Jail & Reviewed Egress
journey_network_jail.description: Raw connect() to 10.0.0.5:5432 trapped by the seccomp-bpf jail (syscall 42) -> remediation: route egress through activated catalog verbs via api catalog

journey_claims_contention.name: Row Claim Contention & Lease Handoff
journey_claims_contention.description: Execution blocked on a held claim (orders:ORD-10, holder agt_9k2w) -> manual lock denied -> unlock denied (caller is not the holder) -> holder releases the lease -> claim reacquired

journey_thrashing_recovery.name: Agent Thrashing Detection & Backoff
journey_thrashing_recovery.description: agent agt_7f3k stuck in a repetitive denial loop (22 denials / 5m, threshold 20) -> harness throttled, escalation + backoff -> re-probe reports a nominal host

journey_vault_secret_provisioning.name: Vault Secret Provisioning (stripe_secret_key)
journey_vault_secret_provisioning.description: stripe.refund_charge refused (stripe_secret_key absent from vault) -> vault gates (value required via --in @-, env vars required for import-env) -> out-of-band injection lands -> pinned capability executes with the vault provisioned

journey_cron_binding_lifecycle.name: Cron Binding Lifecycle (bnd_3k2f)
journey_cron_binding_lifecycle.description: Empty binding registry -> cron binding gauntlet (intent required, 5-minute interval floor, 20-schedule cap) -> nightly_sync bound -> list + inspect -> pause -> resume -> remove -> the dismantled id refuses every management verb

journey_webhook_ingress.name: Webhook Ingress Binding Gauntlet
journey_webhook_ingress.description: stripe payment_succeeded hook: public --ingress required (raw 127.0.0.1 denied) -> HMAC-SHA256 signing secret must be armed in the vault -> 50-hook cap -> 64KB payload ceiling -> hook bound

journey_endpoint_exposure.name: Endpoint Exposure, Partner Keys & Manifest Export
journey_endpoint_exposure.description: Expose a routine over HTTP: unpinned trust denied -> endpoint cap (10) -> pinned dispatch_order@4 endpoint bound -> partner API key issued (25-key cap first) -> OpenAPI and MCP manifests exported

journey_doc_reading.name: Doc Pointer Resolution & Reading
journey_doc_reading.description: Pointer hunt: outline on a missing doc://return-policy refuses, read on the typo'd doc://refund-policies refuses -> the live refund-policy doc reads fully, slices to 100 tokens, outlines, and inspects

journey_env_lifecycle.name: Environment Lifecycle: Provision, Audit, Promote, Deprovision
journey_env_lifecycle.description: Seed staging from prod -> provisioning gates (name taken, template pack size limit, namespace cap) -> switch & audit namespaces (list, inspect) -> env doctor drift then healthy -> merge gauntlet to prod (unmerged, lockfile, plan conflict, trust) -> forward merge lands -> deprovision gauntlet (crypto sig, unverified final backup, unknown id) -> experiment_2 removed

journey_ping_lifecycle.name: Ping: Notifications, Inquiries & Fail-Closed Expiry
journey_ping_lifecycle.description: Empty pending queue -> notify gauntlet (intent required, unconfigured channel webhook, transport failure fail-closed, unknown recipient, quiet hours) -> ask gates (intent required, options cap) -> ask suspends a frame (exit 6) -> resolution gauntlet (unknown id, OCC fence, timeout expiry) -> unresolved ask expires fail-closed

journey_rule_governance.name: Rule Governance: Validate, Show, Diff, Apply
journey_rule_governance.description: Validate gauntlet (syntax errors, then semantic errors, then valid) -> show compiled rules (unknown table refuses, orders compiles) -> diff vs HEAD (lockstep, then one pending orders.priority change) -> apply gates (DDL trust floor, lockfile sync, validation) -> DDL applied to dev

journey_db_operations.name: DB Storage Operations: Schema, Lock, Dump, Snapshot, Restore
journey_db_operations.description: Schema survey (fresh workspace empty, then the orders table) -> lock gate (reason required) -> dump shapes (full, then over-cap truncated) -> snapshot gates (prod draft denial, then created) -> restore gauntlet (missing id, active locks, then a clean restore)

journey_api_lifecycle.name: Provider Lifecycle: Sync, Diff, Catalog, Prove, Ship, Retire
journey_api_lifecycle.description: Sync gates (spec url required, rate ceiling) -> stripe spec synced -> drift diff (threads clean, stripe populated) -> catalog shapes (empty, truncated, populated) -> prove gates (sim gap, policy) -> stripe.refund_charge passes in sim -> ship ladder (reason required, replay metrics, shipped, graduated) -> stats -> rollback gauntlet (depth, unknown version, restored) -> retirement

journey_routine_lifecycle.name: Routine Lifecycle: Author, Prove, Ship, Queue
journey_routine_lifecycle.description: Draft instantiated via template scaffold -> prove gauntlet (exit-3 compiler refusals: syntax, param cap, missing docstring, oversized output; then exit-2 gates: shape, sandbox escape, forbidden leaf op) -> sim prove passes -> two promotion routes: the review path (enqueue via ship --queue, supervisor pending inspection, human batch sign-off ships) beside the direct ship ladder (reason required, trust floor, replay metrics) -> order_sync pinned ship -> canary rolled back -> promotion queue drained empty

journey_routine_maintenance.name: Routine Fleet Maintenance: Sweep, Stats, Rollback, Retire
journey_routine_maintenance.description: Sweep (quiet window, then stale drafts harvested) -> profile gates (unknown routine, then dispatch_order deep stats) -> rollback gauntlet (unknown version, depth ceiling, then sync_orders restored to v3) -> retire gauntlet (active dependencies, unknown routine, unjustified prod retire refused, then legacy_etl retired with loud bound-ingress teardown)

journey_identity_control.name: Agent Identity Control: Register, List, Revoke
journey_identity_control.description: Empty agent registry -> first agent registered -> roster populated -> registry hits capacity -> revoke gauntlet (unknown id refuses, then the live agent revokes and frees a slot)

journey_backup_recovery.name: Workspace Backup & Snapshot Recovery
journey_backup_recovery.description: Dual-storage backup push rejected (git non-fast-forward, s3 403) -> retry lands -> recovery gauntlet (unknown commit, active claim leases) -> workspace restored from the 3f9c2ab checkpoint

journey_serve_lifecycle.name: Daemon Serve Lifecycle
journey_serve_lifecycle.description: Daemon start gauntlet: foreign pid holds 127.0.0.1:4040 (EADDRINUSE) -> second start refused (own daemon already bound) -> clean start on a free port reports the daemon running

journey_inbox_drain.name: Sensory Inbox Drain
journey_inbox_drain.description: Channel-less pop finds nothing queued -> channel-scoped pop drains the queued webhook batch (shopify orders + refund request)

journey_sandbox_exec.name: Sandboxed Subprocess Execution
journey_sandbox_exec.description: bwrap escape attempt denied (pivot_root remount + ptrace outside the profile) -> retry SIGSEGVs in a native extension (jail torn down, scratch wiped) -> after pinning the extension the sandboxed run completes

journey_doctor_boot.name: Doctor Boot Gauntlet & Host Drift
journey_doctor_boot.description: Boot-check refuses on a tier_1 host missing the bwrap sandbox floor -> lockfile root-hash mismatch refuses boot -> live schema drift denies (orders.idx_orders_status, customers.region) -> after re-sync the doctor passes with only benign clock drift reported

journey_secret_leak_containment.name: Exit-5 Secret Leak: Kill, Rotate, Re-Prove
journey_secret_leak_containment.description: Plaintext stripe_secret_key detected in routine stdout -> kill_and_alert tears the session down -> credential rotated out-of-band via the vault -> the Stripe refund verb re-proves clean in sim

journey_media_loss_recovery.name: Exit-5 Total Media Loss & Break-Glass Recovery
journey_media_loss_recovery.description: Ledger root unreadable and the S3 WORM checkpoint missing (chain unverifiable end-to-end) -> kill_and_alert, boot refused -> CAPCLI_RECOVERY=1 break-glass shell: policy disabled, audit sink online, recovery mode logged

journey_execution_gates.name: Execution Gates: Authorizer, Trust Ladder, Tier Ceiling
journey_execution_gates.description: Authorizer blocks the immutable-column email rewrite on customer_migrate@2 -> draft sync_inventory@3 denied in prod (production floor requires reviewed) -> pinned dispatch_order@4 denied on a degraded tier_2 darwin host -> pinned on tier_1 executes cleanly

journey_crash_recovery.name: Exit-4 Crash Triage & Recovery Paths
journey_crash_recovery.description: Guest TypeError escapes enrich_customers@2 (ops auto-reverted) -> workspace recovered from the object-store checkpoint -> next job hits the 30s poll ceiling -> snapshot restore -> the sim re-prove of sync_orders crashes on a None arithmetic bug -> rolled back to the last good version -> the stripe.issue_credit_note contract replay crashes on an upstream union type -> provider spec re-synced

journey_sql_gatekeeper.name: SQL Gatekeeper Tour (run sql)
journey_sql_gatekeeper.description: Typo SQL refuses to parse -> write without -m intent refuses -> unbounded UPDATE denied at the AST gate -> DROP TABLE denied by the authorizer -> bounded UPDATE denied while the engine is busy -> legal shapes: DDL dry-run, then the bounded keyed write

journey_search_discovery.name: Search Surface & Gap Sweep
journey_search_discovery.description: Novel query finds nothing (kombucha supplier sync) -> 'order' hits populate -> 'stripe' overflows the result cap -> the 7d gap sweep surfaces zero-result and low-conversion queries and proposes authoring a draft routine or expanding the catalog

journey_overview_briefing.name: Situational Briefing: Full vs Oversized Refusal
journey_overview_briefing.description: Single-shot domain briefing: the full overview lands under the 500-token aggregate ceiling -> the routine bloats to 612 tokens and the result gate refuses the oversized aggregate (exit 3): aggregates paginate never, clip never

journey_inspect_preflight.name: Pre-Flight Envelopes Across URP Types
journey_inspect_preflight.description: Bare pointer refuses to resolve -> draft cap://refund_and_archive@1 denied by the trust gate -> tpl://routine/webhook_receiver blueprint via capcli inspect -> quota://threads budget envelope -> pinned cap://dispatch_order@4 routine envelope

journey_large_result_delivery.name: Large Result Delivery: Clip or Redirect
journey_large_result_delivery.description: Big payloads: the orders export SELECT clips at the result cap -> same query lands clean via --out -> the quarterly report run clips -> same run redirects to disk with a token-lean summary

journey_template_lifecycle.name: Template Lifecycle: Author, Validate, Pack, Sync, Import, Scaffold, Prove
journey_template_lifecycle.description: Blueprint authored via template new -> bundle lint via rule validate -> bundle compiled via template pack -> registry index refreshed via template sync -> bundle registered via template import -> draft routine instantiated via template scaffold -> sim prove via routine prove
